scope: Migration tooling only; no real UWB method validation
verified_behaviors: Historical loader configurations, provenance and source matrices are included; checkpoints excluded
Byte-identical multi-chunk round trip with original inputs preserved
Experimental worktree source takes priority and preserves CRLF bytes
Corruption and missing chunks stop before restoring files
Missing required historical files stop before export
Code-only export excludes dependency directories and .env files
Portable paths reject traversal and Windows absolute paths
Original file hashes are checked after decompression
Occupied and nested output directories are rejected
powershell_limit: Cloud has no PowerShell; wrapper reviewed but not run on user's Windows machine
